roundProgress.hint: Enrolled tasks completed in the current round

reopen.body: Each reopened task keeps its identity and documents and starts a fresh run under a new round.
reopen.blockedHint: This task's current round is still running — it must finish before it can be reopened.
reopen.error: Couldn't reopen the selected tasks. Please try again.
reopen.errorForbidden: You don't have permission to reopen these tasks.

customerRevision.actionHint: A customer input changed: redo the work built on its earlier revision
customerRevision.title: Apply customer revision
customerRevision.intro: The selected tasks get the customer's new revision of each input and go back through the delivery loop. Nothing is deleted, and the reset is recorded with your reason.
customerRevision.noInputs: This project has no input documents yet. Upload the customer's new revision on the Documents tab first.
customerRevision.staleTasks_one: {{count}} task works from an earlier revision
customerRevision.staleTasks_other: {{count}} tasks work from an earlier revision
customerRevision.tasksHint: Tasks working from an earlier revision are selected. Add a task that never received the input, or clear one the change does not touch.
customerRevision.tasksPickInput: Select a changed input to see the tasks it affects.
customerRevision.tasksNone: No task works from an earlier revision of these inputs. Select the tasks to redo yourself.
customerRevision.effectTasks_one: {{count}} task gets the new revision of the input.
customerRevision.effectTasks_other: {{count}} tasks get the new revision of the input.
customerRevision.effectCancel: Work still running on these tasks stops. Finished work stays as it is.
customerRevision.effectAfc: Their documents approved for construction (AFC) reopen for revision. Documents of other tasks stay AFC.
customerRevision.effectTransmittals_one: {{count}} sent transmittal carried this work. It stays as sent; the next transmittal carries the redone work.
customerRevision.effectTransmittals_other: {{count}} sent transmittals carried this work. They stay as sent; the next transmittal carries the redone work.

reentry.newRun: The delivery run has finished, so a new delivery run starts from Project Triage. The finished run and its transmittals stay in the project history.
reentry.currentRound: The tasks rejoin the current round and Dept. Triage reopens them. If a transmittal is out for the customer's review, record the customer's outcome there: applying does not answer it.
reentry.none: This project has no workflow, so nothing restarts. The change is recorded and the tasks are reworked by hand.

customerRevision.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Customer transmittal BR-0412: datasheet rev D, range changed to 0–60 bar
customerRevision.reasonHint: Required. Shown on the project timeline and on each affected task.
customerRevision.previewError: Couldn't work out what this would affect. Please try again.

error.generic: Couldn't apply the customer revision. Please try again.
error.forbidden: You don't have permission to apply a customer revision to this project.
error.document_not_project_input: One of the chosen documents is not an input of this project.
error.document_has_no_revision: One of the chosen inputs has no uploaded revision yet.
error.task_not_in_project: One of the selected tasks is not in this project.
error.engine_required: The workflow engine is not reachable, so the delivery run cannot restart. Please try again later.
error.request_id_reused: This request was already used for another project. Close the dialog and start again.

customerRevision.pendingCancel_one: Applied, but {{count}} running task has not stopped yet.
customerRevision.pendingCancel_other: Applied, but {{count}} running tasks have not stopped yet.

workflowRevision.notice: A newer version of this project’s workflow is published: v{{to}}. This project runs v{{from}}.
workflowRevision.hint: Moving it changes only the next delivery run, the one a customer revision starts after AFC. Work already running stays on v{{from}}.
workflowRevision.title: Move this project to workflow v{{to}}?
workflowRevision.body: The project’s next delivery run uses workflow v{{to}}. The run in progress and every task keep v{{from}}. The move is recorded in the project history.
workflowRevision.error: Couldn't move the project. Please try again.
workflowRevision.success: The project now uses workflow v{{to}} for its next delivery run.
